questions.question: What is sleep debt?

options.text: When you don't get enough sleep
When you want to take a nap
The time you need after sleeping before you can drive

questions.correctAnswerText: When you don't get enough sleep
questions.explanation: Sleep debt happens when you don't sleep enough. You can only pay back this debt by getting more sleep.

questions.question: When turning, you should:

options.text: Turn off your signal just before you turn.
Signal only if there are cars in front of you.

questions.explanation: Turn on your turn signal well before you turn or change lanes. Keep it on during the entire turn. Turn it off after the turn is complete if your vehicle doesn't do this automatically.

questions.question: All trailers made after ____ must have Anti-Lock Braking Systems (ABS).
questions.explanation: All trailers and converter dollies made on or after March 1, 1998 must have Anti-Lock Braking Systems (ABS).

questions.question: You should check and adjust your mirrors:
questions.explanation: Check your mirrors before you start driving. Your position changes from day to day, so your mirrors may need adjustment.

questions.question: A manifest for transporting hazardous waste:

options.text: Must be attached to the outside of the trailer.

questions.explanation: When transporting hazardous waste, you must carry a Uniform Hazardous Waste Manifest. It must be signed by hand.

questions.question: An Anti-Lock Braking System (ABS) will:

options.text: Let you drive faster than normal.
Let you follow other vehicles more closely than normal.
Let you drive less carefully than normal.

questions.explanation: ABS helps you keep control when braking hard. However, it doesn't necessarily make you stop in a shorter distance.

questions.question: Keeping cargo centered on a rig can:
questions.explanation: A rollover is more likely when cargo is loaded unevenly. Keep cargo centered on the rig to help prevent a rollover.

questions.question: If you are driving at a reduced speed in a construction zone and see a construction worker near the road, you should:
questions.explanation: Always drive slowly in construction zones. Slow down even more when you see workers on or near the road.

questions.question: A truck tractor built after March 1, 1997 must have:
questions.explanation: Truck tractors with air brakes made on or after March 1, 1997 must have Anti-Lock Braking Systems (ABS).

questions.question: Bridges usually freeze:

options.text: Only when temperatures drop well below 32 degrees Fahrenheit.

questions.explanation: Bridges freeze before other parts of the road. Be extra careful on bridges when it is near freezing.

questions.question: During a trip, gauges help you:

options.text: Are the only way to know if your vehicle has problems.
Spot possible problems with your vehicle.

questions.correctAnswerText: Spot possible problems with your vehicle.
questions.explanation: During a trip, check your gauges, mirrors, tires, cargo, and lights often. These checks help you find vehicle problems early.

questions.question: You may be an aggressive driver if you:

options.text: Plan for delays during your drive.
Drive slowly and keep a safe distance from other cars.
Make angry hand gestures at other drivers.

questions.correctAnswerText: Make angry hand gestures at other drivers.
questions.explanation: Do not be an aggressive driver. Plan extra time for your trip, keep a safe distance from other vehicles, and never make hand gestures that could upset other drivers.

questions.question: When checking your engine, you should NOT check:
questions.explanation: Check your engine oil level, radiator coolant level and hose condition, power steering fluid level and hose condition, windshield washer fluid level, battery connections and fluid level, automatic transmission fluid level, and belt condition. Also look for leaks and damaged wiring. Do not check the fuel level in the engine compartment.

questions.question: What is the only way to sober up after drinking alcohol?
questions.explanation: Your body removes alcohol at a fixed rate. Cold showers, exercise, and coffee cannot speed this up. Time is the only way to sober up.

questions.question: What affects your stopping distance?
questions.explanation: Stopping distance depends on your vehicle's speed, weight, and how well the tires grip the road.

questions.question: An Anti-Lock Braking System (ABS):

options.text: Makes you stop in a shorter distance.
Makes you need more distance to stop.
Makes a loud squeaking sound when used.
Helps you keep control while braking.

questions.correctAnswerText: Helps you keep control while braking.
questions.explanation: ABS helps you stay in control when you brake. It does not necessarily change how far you need to stop.

questions.question: To check if a trailer has ABS, you can:

options.text: Look under the trailer for wheel speed sensors behind the brakes.
Drive on a wet surface and see if ABS activates.
Remove a tire and look for an ABS sensor on the axle.

questions.correctAnswerText: Look under the trailer for wheel speed sensors behind the brakes.
questions.explanation: Trailers made after March 1, 1998 must have ABS. On older trailers, look under the trailer for wires and sensors behind the brakes to see if ABS is installed.

questions.question: If your trailer moves off course while backing up, you should:

options.text: Drive forward, readjust, and back up again.
Get out and push the trailer into position.
Turn the steering wheel all the way left until it straightens.

questions.correctAnswerText: Drive forward, readjust, and back up again.
questions.explanation: If your trailer goes off course while backing, pull forward to reposition your truck, then back up again.

questions.question: When loading a tank, you must leave space for outage. What is outage?

options.text: Space for luggage and personal items.

questions.explanation: Liquids expand when they heat up. A tank with liquid must have extra empty space called "outage" to hold this expansion.

questions.question: Rearward amplification means:

options.text: Loud noise at the back of the vehicle.
The cause of the whip-like effect on trailers.
How many trailers one truck can pull.

questions.correctAnswerText: The cause of the whip-like effect on trailers.
questions.explanation: Rearward amplification causes a whip-like effect on trailers. If not handled properly, this can cause a trailer to tip over.
